_about: Hand-written plain-language summaries, written from each project's own description and README. [what it helps you do, jobs it's for, setup: 1 easy, 2 some setup, 3 technical]. Jobs: dev, vibe, design, marketing, writing, research, data, office, security, devops, ai, science.
